biotools.summary: MetaFX is an open-source library for feature extraction from whole-genome metagenomic sequencing data and classification of sample groups, distributed via Bioconda and peer-reviewed with an evaluation on 590 human gut metagenome samples for inflammatory bowel disease prediction.
